title: Dedup/rerank/fusion
decisions: RRF now rejects a weights/result-list cardinality mismatch instead of silently truncating through zip.
Deduplication and equal-score fusion use document-ID tie breaks so input order cannot change the selected result.
risks: Jaccard token overlap is a transparent near-duplicate heuristic, not semantic equivalence.
follow_up: P04-T10 records the retrieval quality audit and evidence.
